title: Probabilistic generation of two-mode binomial cat states using cross-Kerr interactions
summary: Superpositions of macroscopically distinct coherent states, or cat states, are a key resource for quantum technologies. In particular, two-mode binomial cat states can give rise to exact quantum error correction in continuous-variable quantum computing. However, their preparation typically requires non-Gaussian initial states, such as Fock or NOON states, which are challenging to realize experimentally.
